propositions: current sidecar persistence tests inspect final json and replacement mechanics rather than validating the write window and preventing last-writer record loss
live sidecars in peer_confirmations and impossible_links replace full snapshots without coordinated locking or conflict detection across concurrent writers
existing prior art implements sibling-file locked read-modify-write patterns in hlc and recent_creates that must be generalized into a single reusable exclusive-path-lock primitive in fsutil
mapping and provenance mutations must load the current valid state under a shared lock before applying key-level mutations and publishing via fsutil.atomic_write

peer-confirmation and impossible-link stores must calculate upserts and deletions from an independent deep copy of load-time records and apply deltas while holding the shared lock to detect concurrent modifications

persistence failures including malformed json lock acquisition failures or atomic-write failures must log warnings preserve target bytes and allow reconciliation to continue without overwriting stale state
